name: og-rtca-autocatalysis
gate_reason: Gate A keystone, branched-skeleton v2: endogenous autocatalysis of the CANONICAL reductive-TCA cycle is refuted UNDER VENT CONDITIONS, with mechanism. On a coefficient-independent functional discriminator (seed-dependence / self-maintained carbon fixation vs a degree-preserving matched null), a seeded oxaloacetate nucleus washes out across the x1–x50 feed sweep at the real vent-H2 thermodynamics (net flux ≤ 0, not self-maintained): the reductive carboxylations (succinate→α-ketoglutarate ΔG° +18, acetyl→pyruvate +31 kJ/mol) run uphill under H2 and too slow against washout, so the citrate-lyase autocatalytic loop never closes — the same reason real rTCA uses ferredoxin, not H2. The rTCA topology is nonetheless shown autocatalysis-CAPABLE and topology-SPECIFIC in a labelled stronger-reductant / lower-dilution counterfactual (NOT a vent claim), so A2 is resolved as a redox-environment limitation, not a limitation of the cycle's wiring. The coefficient-gated autocatalytic_gain reads 0 by construction (topological autocatalysis, no coefficient-2 reaction), which is why the functional discriminator is used.
title: Reductive-TCA Autocatalysis (branched v2)
claim: Under vent conditions (H2 as reductant) a seeded reductive-TCA cycle does not self-amplify - it washes out across the x1-x50 feed sweep. The cycle is genuinely autocatalytic in topology: its net turn, 1 oxaloacetate + 4 CO2 + 5 H2 -> 2 oxaloacetate + 3 H2O, doubles the carrier oxaloacetate with no explicit coefficient-2 doubling reaction, so a coefficient detector reads zero by construction and a coefficient-free functional discriminator is required to judge it. Under vent H2 it fails that test: the reductive carboxylations that close the cycle (succinate to alpha-ketoglutarate, +18 kJ/mol; acetyl to pyruvate, +31 kJ/mol) run uphill and too slow against washout - the same reason the biological reductive TCA cycle uses ferredoxin, not H2, as its reductant. In a labelled permissive counterfactual that lowers the carboxylation barrier, the same topology meets the self-amplification bar and is topology-specific (a degree-preserving null does not), so the vent negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a defect of the cycle's wiring. The counterfactual is explicitly not a vent claim.
question: Does the canonical reductive-TCA cycle — the branched-C6 route that the linear-skeleton formose universe (og-29) cannot represent — turn over and self-amplify under vent CO2/H2 feeds (feasibility), and does its specific wiring self-amplify beyond a degree-preserving matched null (topology-specificity)?
hypothesis: Curated with its real branched intermediates (citrate/isocitrate/cis-aconitate) and eQuilibrator thermodynamics, the rTCA cycle's citrate-lyase branch (citrate → OAA + acetyl, acetyl recycled to a second OAA) is autocatalytic by topology (every elementary step 1:1, no coefficient-2 reaction). A functional, coefficient-independent discriminator will reveal whether that topology actually self-amplifies under vent feeds; if it does not, the analysis names the rate-limiting/thermodynamic step rather than tuning a pass.
experiment: Build the curated mechanistic rTCA network as a real libRoadRunner reaction universe (same engine, feeds, eQuilibrator thermodynamics and matched-null machinery as Phase 3), grade it by the functional autocatalysis discriminator across the ignition sweep against a degree-preserving matched null, and report feasibility + topology-specificity honestly with the governing mechanism.
design_notes: A curated rTCA network CANNOT test whether autocatalysis EMERGES — the cycle is hand-coded, present by construction (that was the formose / rule-generated question in og-29, which was refuted). It tests two different things: (a) thermodynamic/kinetic FEASIBILITY — does the known cycle turn over and self-amplify under vent feeds (ignition sweep)? and (b) topology-SPECIFICITY — does its wiring self-amplify beyond a degree-preserving matched null on the same compounds/feeds? A positive result means "the canonical rTCA cycle IS viable + self-amplifying under vent conditions," NEVER "autocatalysis emerges." rTCA's autocatalysis is topological (the citrate-lyase branch, all steps 1:1), so the coefficient-gated detector reads gain 0 by construction and the study is graded by the coefficient-independent functional discriminator.

config.title: Reductive-TCA autocatalysis — refuted at vent, topology-capable beyond it
config.caption: Across the x1–x50 vent feed sweep the seeded reductive-TCA cycle shows zero self-amplification growth (it washes out under vent H2 — the honest negative); it ignites only in a labelled stronger-reductant + lower-dilution counterfactual, and topology-specifically (the matched null stays off). So the vent negative is a redox / residence-time limitation, not a limitation of the rTCA wiring.

config.title: Reductive-TCA mechanism — uphill at the vent, topology-capable beyond it

behavior_tests.name: rtca-vent-h2-washout
behavior_tests.description: Under real vent-H2 thermodynamics (carboxylation_drive_kj = 0) a seeded OAA nucleus washes out across the x1–x50 feed sweep — net carbon flux ≤ 0, not self-maintained (functional_autocatalysis False) — because the reductive carboxylations run uphill under H2 and too slow against washout. Refuted.

behavior_tests.name: rtca-topology-net-turn
behavior_tests.description: The curated rTCA universe is element-balanced (residual 0) and its net turn is 1 OAA + 4 CO2 + 5 H2 → 2 OAA + 3 H2O — the carrier doubles with NO coefficient-2 reaction (doubling_reactions empty), so the coefficient detector reads gain 0 by construction.

behavior_tests.name: rtca-permissive-limit-topology-specific
behavior_tests.description: In the labelled permissive counterfactual (lower carboxylation barrier + lower dilution) the cycle meets the self-amplification bar on the functional discriminator (bistable, net-positive fixation) and the degree-preserving matched null does NOT — topology_specific True. Beyond-vent, not a vent claim.

behavior_tests.name: gate-a-a2-branched-resolved
behavior_tests.description: Together with the formose result, Gate A's A2 (endogenous autocatalysis) is resolved for the branched route: self-amplification is refuted under vent conditions, mechanistically, for both representable routes; the topology-capable finding is recorded as a beyond-vent follow-up basis.

rtca-self-amplifies-under-vent.detail: Across the x1–x50 vent feed sweep at real H2 thermodynamics, a seeded oxaloacetate nucleus washes out (net carbon flux ≤ 0, not self-maintained) and never beats the matched null; the reductive carboxylations (succinate→α-KG +18, acetyl→pyruvate +31 kJ/mol) are uphill under H2 and slow vs washout, so the citrate-lyase autocatalytic loop does not close. REFUTED under vent conditions.

rtca-topology-autocatalysis-capable.detail: In the labelled stronger-reductant / lower-dilution counterfactual (NOT a vent claim) the cycle ignites: seeding OAA bootstraps a self-maintained, carbon-fixing cycle (all intermediates populate, bistable) that the feed alone cannot, and the degree-preserving matched null does NOT (topology_specific = True). The rTCA wiring is autocatalysis-capable; the vent negative is a redox-environment limitation (H2 vs ferredoxin) + residence time, not the topology.

formose-crosscheck-functionally-refuted.detail: The same functional discriminator on the rule-generated universe at the formose feed is refuted: the network fixes carbon but production is seed-INDEPENDENT (seeded ≈ unseeded flux) — feed-driven, not self-amplified — confirming og-29 on a coefficient-free basis.

findings.statement: Under vent H2 a seeded reductive-TCA cycle washes out across the x1-x50 sweep and does not self-amplify; the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate to alpha-ketoglutarate, +18 kJ/mol; acetyl to pyruvate, +31 kJ/mol) are uphill and too slow against washout, mirroring the real cycle's need for ferredoxin rather than H2.

The cycle is autocatalytic in topology - its net turn (1 oxaloacetate + 4 CO2 + 5 H2 -> 2 oxaloacetate + 3 H2O) doubles the carrier oxaloacetate with no explicit coefficient-2 doubling reaction - so a coefficient detector reads gain 0 by construction and only a coefficient-free functional discriminator can judge it. (Acetate is used as an acetyl-CoA surrogate; fumarate is lumped.)

In a labelled permissive counterfactual that lowers the carboxylation barrier, the rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar on the coefficient-free discriminator and is topology-specific - a degree-preserving null does not switch on - so the vent-condition negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a limitation of the cycle's wiring. This counterfactual is explicitly beyond-vent and is not a vent claim.

With the formose result, this resolves Gate A's A2 (endogenous autocatalysis) for the branched route - self-amplification is refuted under vent conditions, mechanistically, for both representable routes - and records the topology-capable finding as the basis for a possible stronger-reductant / beyond-vent follow-up, outside current vent scope.

limitations: Curated network — tests feasibility + topology-specificity, NOT emergence. The autocatalytic topology is hand-coded (present by construction); this study cannot and does not claim autocatalysis "emerges" (that was og-29's rule-generated question, refuted). A positive is "the canonical rTCA cycle is viable + self-amplifying under these conditions," never "autocatalysis emerged."

The carboxylation_drive_kj knob and the permissive limit (strong drive + faster reductive carboxylation + low dilution) are LABELLED COUNTERFACTUALS used only to separate topology from thermodynamics — they are NOT vent-feasibility claims. The vent result (carboxylation_drive_kj = 0, real feeds) is refuted.

Curation choices (declared): acetyl-CoA is represented by its carbon surrogate ACETATE (no CoA/ATP cofactors) — the approved acetate-surrogate simplification; the thioester (acetyl-CoA / ATP-coupled) variant is the og-12 / study-35 follow-up. Fumarate (an unsaturated C4) is outside the saturated- skeleton representation, so malate → succinate is a single lumped reductive step. ATP/CoA energetics of succinyl-CoA synthetase and ATP-citrate lyase are omitted (treated as rate-processes).

IMPLICATION / possible beyond-vent follow-up (outside current scope): because the rTCA topology is autocatalysis-capable under a stronger reductant, an rTCA cycle driven by a lower-potential reductant than H2 (e.g. the thioester/ferredoxin-surrogate route, og-12) could self-amplify — a candidate future direction, explicitly outside the current vent scope.
